symbolDescription: Replacements for bundled textures and datasets. Anything left out uses the bundled file. Coastlines, borders, elevation and land cover are not replaceable.

optionDescriptions.dayTexture: URL of the equirectangular day imagery used by the `realistic` style.
optionDescriptions.normalMap: URL of the tangent-space normal map used by the `realistic` style.
optionDescriptions.specularMap: URL of the specular (water) mask used by the `realistic` style.
optionDescriptions.cloudsTexture: URL of the cloud layer used by the `realistic` style.
optionDescriptions.countriesGeoJson: URL of, or the parsed, countries FeatureCollection. Raw Natural Earth property names are accepted.
optionDescriptions.capitalsDataset: URL of, or the parsed, capitals array.
